builders.angle: LITERAL -- work BRIEF-r37's fix list 1 to 3 in order and exactly as written, one wing at a time, the Heart FIRST (the round's fight and the lowest of the four, 5 from judge 1). Keep every change inside your four wings.

THE NEAR FLOOR FIRST -- the angle that won rounds 31 and 35 (HEMATITE, ANTHRACITE). Carry round 31's nearFloor rule as rounds 34 and 35 extended it into all four wings -- a dressed, lit near floor with a light pool from a source the room has and props standing IN it above the hand's edge -- prove it there, then each wing's own defect in that light.

THE OBJECT DRAWN, NOT FLAT -- round 34's winning angle. Each wing's worst object is flat: the Heart's pale statues, the Study's blown chandelier blobs and stepped spines, the Pumpkin wall's dark band and lollipop trees. Draw each as a real object with an inked, broken silhouette first -- carved drapery, crisp spines and tamed glass, coping and niches, ragged crowns -- then dress and light the near floor.
